solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Measure piece of copper

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a piece of something is a bit of it

explanation.surface: Someone sizing up a length of copper wire or pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: The cubit is an ancient unit of length, roughly forearm to fingertip, so it is a measure.

clue.text: Daily Mail has no trouble covering top royal Lothario?

indicators.note: in a down answer, covering puts these letters above the royal piece

parts.note: a daily, or char, is a British cleaner who comes in daily

indicators.note: has no means the word for trouble is taken out

parts.note: taken as written before the deletion
to ail is to trouble; an ailment is a trouble
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the Queen, is the top royal

explanation.surface: The Daily Mail happily covering a womanising top royal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Daily Mail' reads as the newspaper; DAILY is a cleaner, CHAR, a British term.
explanation.definitionFit: A Lothario is a seducer of women, a ladies' man who wins them over with charm.

clue.text: Upturned container holding, say, last bit of lemon squash

indicators.note: holding means the container wraps round the next pieces
in a down answer upturned means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a tub is a container
to say something is to utter it

indicators.note: last bit of picks the final letter of the word following

explanation.surface: A container turned over holding the dregs of a lemon drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squash' looks like a fruit drink but is the vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: A butternut is a variety of winter squash with sweet orange flesh, an example of the vegetable.

clue.text: Bone is set in hospital, usually

indicators.note: set in means the letters are found embedded inside these words

explanation.surface: A broken bone is normally set in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: The talus is the ankle bone linking the leg and foot, so it is a bone of the body.

clue.text: Private hospital housed inside lofty public building

indicators.note: one thing housed inside another sits within it, so these pieces go within the word for lofty

parts.note: lofty means tall
private, as in one's private property, means own

explanation.surface: A private hospital set up inside an imposing civic building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Private' looks like an adjective for the hospital but gives OWN.
explanation.definitionFit: A town hall is the civic building housing local government offices, open to the public.

clue.text: One Direction dance hit?

definitions.meaning: a single way to go, the only possible direction, read here as upwards
the 1988 dance chart-topper by the singer Yazz

explanation.surface: A hit song by the boy band One Direction.
explanation.walkthrough: One Direction is the boy band, but the answer is Yazz's hit.
explanation.definitionFit: The title says there is a single possible course, upward, and was a famous dance record.

clue.text: See 4
Servants Her Majesty employs along with general helpers

indicators.note: employs means takes in, so the joining word goes inside the royal abbreviation

parts.note: and means along with
aids are helpers or assistants of a general sort

explanation.surface: The Queen takes on domestic staff and general helpers.
explanation.definitionFit: Handmaids are female attendants or maids, so they are domestic servants.

clue.text: Film director missing start of sad Spielberg movie

indicators.note: missing start of means the first letter of the word for sad is dropped

parts.note: glum means sad
E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial is a 1982 Steven Spielberg film

explanation.surface: A director absent from the opening of a sad Spielberg film.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidney Lumet directed 12 Angry Men, Network and Dog Day Afternoon, so he was a film director.

clue.text: Character in radio series showing greater cunning

definitions.meaning: A long-running BBC radio soap about a farming family
the comparative of arch, meaning slyly knowing

explanation.surface: A radio soap character who is more cunning than others.
explanation.definitionFit: Any member of the farming family in The Archers is one, and arch means sly, so more arch.

clue.text: Some soldiers showing resistance to work during various parts of year

indicators.note: one thing happening during another sits within it, so these letters go inside the rearranged word
various suggests the letters of year in a different arrangement

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance
to work the land is to till it

explanation.surface: Troops show resistance to farm work in different seasons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'various' turns YEAR into AERY, which holds R and TILL.
explanation.definitionFit: The artillery is the branch of an army manning big guns, so it is a body of soldiers.

clue.text: Belgian province where rugby player retired

indicators.note: retired, going back, signals that these letters are read backwards

parts.note: RU stands for Rugby Union
a player in a team is one of its men, a man

explanation.surface: Asking where in Belgium a rugby player settled after retirement.
explanation.definitionFit: Namur is one of the provinces of Wallonia in southern Belgium, named after its capital city.

clue.text: Finds someone to marry, so is no longer top dog?

definitions.meaning: a marriage partner, so finding the perfect partner

definitions.text: so is no longer top dog?
definitions.meaning: to be beaten at last by an equal or better rival

explanation.surface: Someone finds a spouse and loses their dominance in the household.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means encountering an equal opponent, and also literally finding a matching partner for marriage.

clue.text: See 11
Del Shannon hit such a success?

definitions.meaning: the 1961 chart-topping song by the American singer Del Shannon
a success that is overwhelming and easy is described with this word

explanation.surface: Wondering whether Del Shannon's hit was a huge success.
explanation.definitionFit: Runaway was Del Shannon's signature song, and the word also describes a sweeping, unstoppable triumph.

clue.text: Great fun initially with older characters

indicators.note: characters here means letters, which are rearranged into a new order

parts.note: the word fun, then just the opening letter of with, then the word older, pooled as one run of fodder

explanation.surface: Having fun with elderly people is great.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes only W from 'with'; 'characters' reads as people but means the letters of FUN, W and OLDER, shuffled together.
explanation.definitionFit: Wonderful and great are both terms of strong praise, synonyms meaning excellent.

clue.text: Rope old man put in ground

parts.note: one's old man is one's father, pa
to inter someone is to bury them

explanation.surface: A rope used to bury a father, a grim scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rope' is not a verb here but a nautical noun.
explanation.definitionFit: On a boat, a line attached to the bow for tying up is called a painter.

clue.text: Top grades received by everyone attending? That makes a change

indicators.note: received by means taken into the word for those attending

parts.note: the turnout is the number of people who attend
A and B are the top marks in exam grading

explanation.surface: Everyone present gets top marks, which makes a nice change.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnabout is a reversal of position or opinion, so it is a change.

clue.text: I will leave old 15 in charge of ship

indicators.note: one letter will leave, meaning it is removed from the painter's name

parts.note: 15 is the answer PAINTER; Titian was an old Venetian painter

explanation.surface: An old painter leaves while someone is in charge of a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: Titian the Renaissance painter loses one I to give TITAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The Titanic was the liner that sank on its maiden voyage in 1912, a famous vessel.

clue.text: During bash I put on large black hat

indicators.note: during means within, so these letters sit within the word for bash

parts.note: to have a bash is to have a try
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
B is the pencil-grading abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: Someone puts on a big black hat for a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bash' looks like a party; here it means an attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: A trilby is a soft felt hat with a narrow brim and dented crown, an example of a hat.

clue.text: Writer includes mad Lear's daughter among cowards

indicators.note: among puts these letters within the word for cowards

parts.note: chickens are cowards

indicators.note: mad means the letters of the king's name are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, with its S

explanation.surface: A writer's play shows mad King Lear's daughter among cowards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lear' points to Shakespeare's king but his name is just anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Dickens was the Victorian novelist who wrote Oliver Twist and Great Expectations.

clue.text: Teacher fulfilling backward children's needs

indicators.note: fulfilling read as filling, so the teacher's title fills the reversed word
backward signals that the word for children runs in reverse

parts.note: seed means offspring or children
sir is how pupils address a male teacher

explanation.surface: A teacher meeting the needs of slow-learning pupils.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backward' looks like a description of the children but reverses SEED to DEES.
explanation.definitionFit: Desires and needs are both things one wants or craves, so they are near synonyms.

clue.text: See 18
Meet one's family having vacation after end of week

indicators.note: after puts the following pieces behind the weekday piece

parts.note: Saturday, abbreviated Sat, falls at the end of the week
one's, read as I is, gives the two letters

indicators.note: vacation means emptying, so the inside letters of family are removed, leaving the ends

explanation.surface: Meeting relatives on holiday at the weekend.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet a need or requirement is to fulfil it, so to meet is to satisfy.

clue.text: Dante's ancient works about hell initially becoming more influential

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go around the single letter
works suggests the letters are worked into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, with its S

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Dante's old works about Hell growing in influence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'works' looks like a noun for Dante's writings but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rising in power or dominance is said to be on the up, in the ascendant.

clue.text: A short while after tea, say, type of pudding is served

indicators.note: after puts the pudding piece following the first piece
say means the word is spoken, so its sound gives a single letter

parts.note: the drink spoken sounds like a letter of the alphabet
rice pudding is a kind of pudding

explanation.surface: A pudding served after a cup of tea.
explanation.definitionFit: In a trice means in an instant, so a trice is a very short time.

clue.text: See 21
Choppy as any lake in Africa

indicators.note: choppy, like rough water, means the letters are chopped up and rearranged

explanation.surface: An African lake as choppy as any other.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Nyasa, also called Lake Malawi, lies on the borders of Malawi, Mozambique and Tanzania.

clue.text: Lawyer put in the picture

definitions.meaning: a barrister is informally known by this word
to inform someone, to give them the facts

explanation.surface: A lawyer being informed of the facts.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrister is called a brief in slang, and to brief someone is to inform them.

clue.text: Star US general accompanied by military high-ups

parts.note: Robert E Lee was the Confederate general in the American Civil War
majors are senior army officers

explanation.surface: A star general in the US army with his senior officers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star' looks like part of the general's rank but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Lee Majors was a TV actor who starred in The Six Million Dollar Man and The Fall Guy.

clue.text: Small room is too small, principally, for some players

parts.note: a cell is a small room, as in a prison or monastery

indicators.note: principally means first and foremost, so take the opening letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A small room is too cramped for a group of musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: Cellists are musicians who play the cello, so they are players in an orchestra.

clue.text: A short time in work, as is fitting

indicators.note: in signals that the short piece sits inside the word for work

parts.note: to ply a trade is to work at it
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A brief spell of employment, which is appropriate.
explanation.definitionFit: Aptly means suitably or appropriately, the manner of something done as is proper.
